name: GEF Small Grants Programme South Africa
summary: South Africa's SGP country programme funds community-based and civil society organisations through calls for proposals, with OP8 work centred on wildlife economy landscapes and community-led protection of threatened species.
reporting: Grantees submit progress reports to the National Coordinator with a financial report showing evidence of costs, following the programme's reporting templates, and a completion or final report.

geography.quote: In South Africa, GEF SGP started in 2001 and since then it has supported 160 projects

access.quote: Thus, calls for proposals will encourage women-led organisations or those that have active participation of women as well as youth to submit their applications.

reporting.quote: Grantees should submit progress reports to the NC along with a financial report indicating evidence of costs for approval.
